Priya Sharma: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: leadership wants tight, concrete target windows for API improvements, Console UX, and Optimize pilot. can owners + hard blockers be listed here so comms can go out as "targets"?

Marco Valdez: proposed targets (high level): API runtime canary 2024-05-22, GA late May; Console beta (with flags) 2024-06-13, GA late June; Optimize pilot (suggestions) early July. dependencies: quant infra + canary traffic profiles.

Alice Chen: Console note: need per-org flags and admin toggles. target to have flags wired by 2024-06-06 to allow a week of pilot flips.

Dana Liu: SRE ask: SLO pass/fail criteria and canary traffic profiles must be finalized by 2024-05-04 or canary shifts. Evan, we need staging capacity numbers by 2024-04-30.

Sofia Rivas: Optimize alpha scope = suggestion engine + dashboard heatmap. no billing integration or autoscale in alpha. we want 3 pilot customers for feedback.

Evan Park: platform needs confirmed owners + expected qps/burst per-region to reserve quota. please post numbers by EOD.

Ben Ortiz: comms owner confirmed. i'll present these as "target windows, dependent on infra & SLO gating" and hold final publish until canary starts.

Marco Valdez: owners (tentative): Marco -> API runtime; Alice -> Console rollout; Sofia -> Optimize suggestions; Dana + Evan -> infra/SLOs; Ben -> comms. i'll update the roadmap doc with blocking columns.

deploy-bot: queued: provision staging GPUs for api canary 2024-05-02 03:00 UTC :robot_face:
